entries.definition: To close off within a boundary, often on paper or in a wall.
entries.definitionCN: 在界线内封闭，常用于信封或围墙。

entries.definition: To cover so that sight is blocked, with a funerary image.
entries.definitionCN: 遮盖至不可见，带裹尸布的意象。

entries.definition: To take in as a gulf does, stronger and more violent.
entries.definitionCN: 如深渊吞入，语气更强更猛。

normalIntro.en: Envelop without the final e is the verb; with an extra e it becomes the paper noun.
normalIntro.cn: 动词是 envelop，多写一个 e 就成了信封这个名词。

normal.en: The verb has one p; the noun envelope has two.
normal.cn: 动词只有一个 p，名词 envelope 有两个。

normal.en: Fog, smoke, darkness, and silence are the usual subjects.
normal.cn: 雾、烟、黑暗与沉默是最常见的主语。

normal.en: Use the passive for weather: the village was enveloped in mist.
normal.cn: 写天气多用被动：村庄被雾霭笼罩。

normal.en: In military prose envelop names a flanking movement.
normal.cn: 军事文体中 envelop 指迂回包抄行动。

normal.en: Do not use it for folding letters; that is the noun's job.
normal.cn: 不要用动词指封信动作，那是名词的领域。

abstract.en: Picture mist rolling in from four directions at once.
abstract.cn: 想象雾气从四个方向同时漫拢过来。

abstract.en: Imagine a blanket pulled over a sleeping child.
abstract.cn: 想象给熟睡的孩子拉上一床毯子。

abstract.en: Think of a crowd closing so a single figure disappears inside it.
abstract.cn: 想想人群合拢，一个人的身影消失其中。

examples.en: Ash soon enveloped the hillside villages.
examples.cn: 火山灰很快笼罩了山坡上的村庄。

examples.en: A hush enveloped the hall before the speech.
examples.cn: 演讲开始前大厅一片寂静。

examples.en: The plan was to envelop the bridge from both banks.
examples.cn: 计划是从两岸包围桥头。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因围了铺」——因为围起来像铺了一层布，所以 envelop 是笼罩、包围；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（向内）＋ volvere（滚）→ involvere（卷入）→ 古法语 envellir → 中古英语 envelopen → 现代英语 envelop，核心义「从四周滚拢包住」。

sensesIntro.en: The verb covers physical wrapping, a tactical encirclement, and the absorption of a thing into an atmosphere.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词涵盖实体包裹、战术合围，以及事物被氛围吞没。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something rolled around an object until no edge shows.
core.cn: 核心意象：把物体层层裹住，直到看不见边缘。

branches.en: Weather and fire supply the literal covering sense.
branches.cn: 天气与火焰构成本义的覆盖。

branches.en: Tactics turn covering into a planned encirclement.
branches.cn: 战术把覆盖变为有计划的合围。

branches.en: Crowds and moods swallow outlines altogether.
branches.cn: 人群与情绪把轮廓完全吞没。

branches.en: Both hide the thing from sight.
branches.cn: 两者都让对象从视线中消失。

branches.en: Both move inward from every side at once.
branches.cn: 两者都从各方同时向内收拢。

intro.en: A Latin rolling stem is prefixed twice over in this family, yielding verbs and nouns.
intro.cn: 拉丁语表滚动的词干在本词族被反复加前缀，产出动词与名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin Volvere is to roll, involvere to wrap in, and revolvere to roll back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 volvere 表滚动，involvere 表包裹，revolvere 表转回。

items.exampleCN: en- 位于 envelop 开头。
法语形式塑造了英语词形。

items.example: The noun took the French infinitive shape.
items.exampleCN: 名词采用法语不定式形式。

items.example: A sibling borrowing of the stem.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干的另一借入形式。

definition_zh: 令人羡慕的；招人嫉妒的
definition_en: likely to make others wish they had the same quality, position, or possession
core_image: 同事齐刷刷望向那张刚公布的名额表，眼神里既有赞叹也有坐不住的酸意
scene: 她的保研名额让全班侧目。She won an enviable place on the programme.
sceneCN: 这里 enviable 是「令人羡慕的」（第 1 个义项：好到让别人也想要）；句意：她拿到了令人羡慕的名额。

pos.zh: 令人羡慕的；招人嫉妒的

senses.title: Good enough to be wished for
senses.definition: describing a quality or advantage that other people would like to have themselves
senses.definitionCN: 形容他人也想拥有的优点或有利条件
senses.example: He has an enviable memory for names.
senses.exampleCN: 他对名字的记忆力令人羡慕。
senses.why: The adjective points outward at the reaction it causes in onlookers.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词指向外部，描述旁观者被激起的反应。

senses.title: Exposed to hostile jealousy
senses.definition: placing a person so prominently that ill will rather than praise follows
senses.definitionCN: 把人推到显要位置，随之而来的不是赞美而是敌意
senses.example: Success put her in an enviable glare.
senses.exampleCN: 成功把她推上了受人嫉视的聚光灯下。
senses.why: Older writing kept the bitter half of envy, so the position itself is the danger.
senses.whyCN: 早期文本保留了 envy 苦涩的一半，因此处境本身就是风险。

senses.title: Large enough to draw notice
senses.definition: used of quantities and collections whose size invites comparison
senses.definitionCN: 形容数量或收藏的规模大到引人比较
senses.example: The library holds an enviable archive of maps.
senses.exampleCN: 该图书馆的地图藏量相当可观。
senses.why: The sense slides from personal merit to anything counted and displayed.
senses.whyCN: 词义从个人优点扩展到一切可清点又可展示的东西。

intro.en: Enviable is envy plus the suffix -able, shaped through French from Latin invidere, to look at with spite.
intro.cn: enviable 由 envy 加词尾 -able 构成，经法语取自拉丁语 invidere，意为怀着恶意注视。

items.en: Videre means to see.
items.cn: videre 意为看。

items.en: Invidere means to look at grudgingly, and invidia names spite.
items.cn: invidere 意为眼红地看，invidia 指嫉恨。

items.en: Envie carries the Latin noun into French.
items.cn: envie 把拉丁名词带入法语。

items.en: English takes envy as noun and verb.
items.cn: 中古英语把 envy 同时用作名词和动词。

items.en: The adjective enviable appears, borrowed from French enviable.
items.cn: 十六世纪出现形容词 enviable，借自法语 enviable。

items.en: The word narrows to praise, while envious keeps the blame.
items.cn: 现代英语中该词偏向赞美，贬义留给 envious。

note.en: Group one holds the videre family and the adverb; group two holds other adjectives of deserving notice.
note.cn: 第一组是 videre 词族与副词形式；第二组是其他表示值得关注的形容词。

entries.definition: Describes the jealous person, not the admired thing.
entries.definitionCN: 描述嫉妒者而非被羡慕的对象。

entries.definition: Marks an action done in a way others admire.
entries.definitionCN: 修饰以令人羡慕的方式做出的动作。

entries.definition: Likely to provoke resentment or unfair comparison.
entries.definitionCN: 容易激起不满或引发不公正的比较。

entries.definition: Built on the videre stem of seeing ahead.
entries.definitionCN: 同样建在 videre 这一预见词干上。

entries.definition: Worthy of approval without any sting of jealousy.
entries.definitionCN: 值得赞许，不带嫉忌的酸味。

entries.definition: Described as the object of another's desire.
entries.definitionCN: 被他人强烈渴望的对象。

entries.definition: Held in great worth by those who own or admire it.
entries.definitionCN: 为拥有者或仰慕者所珍视。

entries.definition: Pleasant enough to be sought after, milder in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 好到值得追求，语气更平缓。

normalIntro.en: Enviable describes the admired side; envious describes the jealous side.
normalIntro.cn: enviable 说的是被羡慕的一方，envious 说的是眼红的一方。

normal.en: The -able ending means able to cause envy in others.
normal.cn: -able 词尾表示能在他人身上激起嫉妒。

normal.en: It usually modifies a thing: record, position, range, talent.
normal.cn: 它多修饰事物：成绩、位置、范围、才能。

normal.en: Pair it with has or won, not with feels.
normal.cn: 搭配 has 或 won，而不是 feels。

normal.en: In polite speech it softens praise into a compliment.
normal.cn: 客套话里它把赞美软化称恭维。

normal.en: Do not call a person enviable for being pitied.
normal.cn: 被同情的对象不要称作 enviable。

abstract.en: Picture a scoreboard and the long necks of the losing team.
abstract.cn: 想象一块记分牌和落败一方伸长张望的脖子。

abstract.en: Imagine the one seat by the window that everyone requests.
abstract.cn: 想象那个所有人都会点名要靠窗的座位。

abstract.en: Think of a neighbour whose garden always looks better from the street.
abstract.cn: 想想那位从街上看去花园总是更漂亮的邻居。

examples.en: Her fluency gave her an enviable edge in interviews.
examples.cn: 流利的口语让她在面试中占了令人羡慕的优势。

examples.en: An enviable amount of free time fell into his hands.
examples.cn: 他突然有了相当可观的空闲时间。

examples.en: Fame placed the teenager in an enviable and uneasy light.
examples.cn: 名气把这名少年推到既受人眼红又不安的聚光灯下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因未包」——好处因为还没被自己包揽，眼看归了别人，所以 enviable 是令人羡慕的、招人眼红的；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（朝向）＋ videre（看）→ invidere（眼红地看）→ 古法语 envie → 英语 envy ＋ 词尾 -able（能够引起的）→ enviable，核心义「能让别人看着眼红的」。

sensesIntro.en: The adjective moves from admired merit, through exposure to spite, to impressive quantity.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个形容词从被称赞的优点，经招致嫉恨的处境，再到可观的数量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a good thing on display, and the eyes of others drawn to it.
core.cn: 核心意象：好东西摆在明处，旁人的目光被吸引过去。

branches.en: Merit and talent draw approval outward.
branches.cn: 优点与才能向外引来认可。

branches.en: The same attention can turn hostile.
branches.cn: 同样的注视可能转为敌意。

branches.en: Size alone can invite the comparison.
branches.cn: 单是规模就足以引人比较。

branches.en: Both are judged by what others want.
branches.cn: 两者都以他人的渴望来衡量。

branches.en: Both put the subject where it can be measured against peers.
branches.cn: 两者都把对象放到可与同侪比量之处。

intro.en: A seeing stem takes a directional prefix and then a suffix of capacity.
intro.cn: 表看的词干先接受方向前缀，再接受表能力的词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre is to see, invidere to grudge, and providere to foresee.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 表看，invidere 表嫉恨，providere 表预见。

items.example: In- fixes the gaze on another.
items.exampleCN: in- 把目光钉在别人身上。

items.example: The French form shed its initial i.
items.exampleCN: 法语形式脱落了开头的 i。

items.example: Envy is the base of enviable.
items.exampleCN: envy 是 enviable 的基础。

items.example: The ending turns envy into a property.
items.exampleCN: 该词尾把嫉妒变成一种属性。

items.example: A friendly cousin on the same stem.

definition_zh: 环境；周围状况；自然环境
definition_en: the natural world, or the conditions around a person or thing
core_image: 一圈空气、景物与人声把一个人围在中间
scene: 孩子们在安静的环境里读书。The children read in a quiet environment.
sceneCN: 这里 environment 是「周围状况」（第 2 个义项：影响人或事物的周边条件）；句意：孩子们在安静的环境中读书。

pos.zh: 环境；周围状况；自然环境

senses.title: The natural world
senses.definition: the air, water, land, and living things around us, especially when seen as needing protection
senses.definitionCN: 我们周围的空气、水、土地与生物，尤指需要保护的整体
senses.example: We must protect the environment for future generations.
senses.exampleCN: 我们必须为子孙后代保护环境。
senses.why: The word names what surrounds us, and in modern use the whole natural world is the most prominent surround.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指围绕我们的一切，而在现代用法中，整个自然界是最突出的「周围」。

senses.title: Surrounding conditions
senses.definition: the conditions, people, and influences around a person or activity
senses.definitionCN: 围绕某人或某项活动的条件、人与影响
senses.example: A calm environment helps children learn.
senses.exampleCN: 平静的环境有助于孩子学习。
senses.why: The core sense is simply what surrounds, so it applies to homes, schools, and workplaces.
senses.whyCN: 核心含义就是「围绕之物」，因此适用于家庭、学校和工作场所。

senses.title: A computing runtime setting
senses.definition: the software and hardware setting in which a program runs
senses.definitionCN: 程序运行所依赖的软件与硬件设置
senses.example: The program runs in a virtual environment.
senses.exampleCN: 这个程序在虚拟环境中运行。
senses.why: Technical usage treats the surrounding system as the environment of a program.
senses.whyCN: 技术用法把围绕程序的系统视为它的环境。

intro.en: Environment comes from Old French environ, around, plus the noun suffix -ment, so it literally means the state of being surrounded.
intro.cn: environment 来自古法语 environ（在周围）加名词词尾 -ment，字面意思是「被围绕的状态」。

items.en: Viron means a circle or a turn.
items.cn: viron 意为圆圈或一圈。

items.en: Environ means around or surrounding.
items.cn: environ 意为在周围、围绕。

items.en: Environnement names the surrounding conditions.
items.cn: environnement 指周围的条件。

items.en: English environment first means surroundings in general.
items.cn: 英语 environment 最初泛指周围事物。

items.en: Modern English adds the natural world and computing senses.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「自然界」与计算机义项。

note.en: Environment is a surrounding word, with a large family of adjectives and a set of near synonyms for settings.
note.cn: environment 是表示「周围」的词，拥有庞大的形容词词族，以及一组表示场景的近义词。

entries.definition: to surround
entries.definitionCN: 包围；围绕

entries.definition: relating to the environment
entries.definitionCN: 环境的

entries.definition: a person who works to protect nature
entries.definitionCN: 环保人士

entries.definition: everything around a place or person
entries.definitionCN: 周围环境

entries.definition: the place and conditions of an event
entries.definitionCN: 环境；背景

entries.definition: the natural home of a plant or animal
entries.definitionCN: 栖息地

normalIntro.en: Environment is environ plus -ment: the condition of being circled by things.
normalIntro.cn: environment 是 environ 加 -ment：被事物围在中间的状态。

normal.en: Environ means around, so environment is what is around you.
normal.cn: environ 意为在周围，所以 environment 就是你周围的一切。

normal.en: The natural environment is the whole living world.
normal.cn: natural environment 指整个生命世界。

normal.en: The adjective environmental appears in environmental protection.
normal.cn: 形容词 environmental 出现在「环境保护」中。

normal.en: An environmentalist works to protect nature.
normal.cn: environmentalist 是致力于保护自然的人。

normal.en: Compare surroundings: surroundings is more local and physical.
normal.cn: 对比 surroundings：surroundings 更偏局部和物理层面。

abstract.en: Picture a soft ring of air drawn around a standing figure.
abstract.cn: 想象一个站立的人周围画着一圈柔和的气。

abstract.en: Imagine a forest folded around a small village.
abstract.cn: 想象一片森林把一个小村庄环抱起来。

abstract.en: Think of a program sitting inside a glowing frame.
abstract.cn: 想象一个程序坐在发光的框架之内。

examples.en: The factory promised to protect the local environment.
examples.cn: 这家工厂承诺保护当地环境。

examples.en: A friendly environment makes new students feel welcome.
examples.cn: 友好的环境让新生感到受欢迎。

examples.en: Developers tested the app in a secure environment.
examples.cn: 开发者在安全的环境中测试了这个应用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「en + viron」——把你「围」在中间的一切，就是环境；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 environ（在周围）＋ -ment → environment，核心义「被围绕的状态」，引申为周围条件与自然环境。

sensesIntro.en: Environment starts as whatever surrounds us, then narrows to the natural world, and later extends to the setting of a program.
sensesIntro.cn: environment 从「围绕我们的一切」开始，收窄为自然界，后来又扩展到程序的运行环境。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ring of air and scenery drawn around a person.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人周围画着一圈空气与景物。

branches.en: The natural world is the dominant public sense.
branches.cn: 自然界是主要的公共义项。

branches.en: Surrounding conditions keep the oldest spatial sense.
branches.cn: 周围条件保留最古老的空间含义。

branches.en: A runtime setting extends surroundings to software.
branches.cn: 运行环境把「周围」扩展到软件。

branches.en: The natural world is also the largest set of conditions around us.
branches.cn: 自然界也是围绕我们最大的条件集合。

branches.en: Both a classroom and a server provide conditions for activity.
branches.cn: 教室与服务器都为活动提供条件。

intro.en: Environment is environ plus -ment, and its family grows with -al, -ly, and -ist.
intro.cn: environment 由 environ 加 -ment 构成，词族再由 -al、-ly 与 -ist 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The French verb environ, to surround, goes back to viron, a circle or turn.
latinIntro.cn: 法语动词 environ（围绕）可追溯到 viron（圆圈、一圈）。

items.example: Viron gives the image of a circle.

items.exampleCN: environment 指围绕我们的事物。

items.example: Environmentally means with regard to nature.

definition_zh: 环境的；有关环境的；环保的
definition_en: relating to the natural world or to the conditions around something
core_image: 一圈森林和水流围住城市，边上竖着检测牌
scene: 这家公司因违反环保法规而被罚款。The company was fined for breaking environmental rules.
sceneCN: 这里 environmental 是「有关环境的」（第 1 个义项：与自然环境相关）；句意：这家公司因违反环保法规而被罚款。

pos.zh: 环境的；有关环境的；环保的

senses.title: Relating to the natural world
senses.definition: connected with the air, water, land, and living things that surround us
senses.definitionCN: 与我们周围的空气、水、土地和生物相关的
senses.example: The report lists the main environmental problems of the region.
senses.exampleCN: 报告列出了该地区的主要环境问题。
senses.why: The adjective simply adds -al to environment, and the dominant noun sense is the natural world.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词就是 environment 加 -al，而该名词的主要义项是自然界。

senses.title: Relating to surrounding conditions
senses.definition: connected with the conditions that surround a person, place, or activity
senses.definitionCN: 与围绕某人、某地或某项活动的条件有关的
senses.example: Noise is a serious environmental factor in city schools.
senses.exampleCN: 噪音是城市学校中一个严重的环境因素。
senses.why: The older sense of surroundings still appears when conditions rather than nature are meant.
senses.whyCN: 当所指为条件而非自然时，仍会出现「周围环境」这一较老的含义。

senses.title: Designed to protect nature
senses.definition: designed or intended to reduce harm to the natural world
senses.definitionCN: 旨在减少对自然界的损害的
senses.example: They chose an environmental heating system for the new house.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为新房选择了一套环保供暖系统。
senses.why: Because the natural world needs protection, the adjective often carries the practical sense of being eco-friendly.
senses.whyCN: 由于自然界需要保护，这个形容词常带有「对环保有利」的实用含义。

intro.en: Environmental is environment plus -al, tracing back through French environ, around, to viron, a circle.
intro.cn: environmental 是 environment 加 -al，可经法语 environ（在周围）追溯到 viron（圆圈）。

items.en: Viron means a circle or a turn.
items.cn: viron 意为圆圈或一圈。

items.en: Environ means around.
items.cn: environ 意为在周围。

items.en: Environnement names the surroundings.
items.cn: environnement 指周围环境。

items.en: Environment becomes the noun for surroundings.
items.cn: 英语 environment 成为表示周围环境的名词。

items.en: The adjective environmental adds -al and spreads into policy and science.
items.cn: 形容词 environmental 加 -al，并扩展到政策与科学领域。

note.en: Environmental is the adjective of environment, and it sits near other words for ecological concern.
note.cn: environmental 是 environment 的形容词，并与表示生态关切的词相邻。

entries.definition: the surroundings or natural world
entries.definitionCN: 环境；自然界

entries.definition: in relation to the environment
entries.definitionCN: 在环境方面

entries.definition: a person who protects nature
entries.definitionCN: 环保人士

entries.definition: relating to living things and their homes
entries.definitionCN: 生态的

entries.definition: environmentally friendly
entries.definitionCN: 环保的

entries.definition: the protection of nature
entries.definitionCN: 自然保护

normalIntro.en: Environmental is environment with -al, so it describes anything belonging to the surroundings.
normalIntro.cn: environmental 是 environment 加 -al，因此描述任何属于周围环境的事物。

normal.en: Environmental protection means keeping nature safe.
normal.cn: environmental protection 指保护自然。

normal.en: Environmental law controls pollution.
normal.cn: environmental law 管控污染。

normal.en: An environmental impact is an effect on nature.
normal.cn: environmental impact 是对自然的影响。

normal.en: The adverb environmentally appears in environmentally friendly.
normal.cn: 副词 environmentally 出现在 environmentally friendly 中。

normal.en: Compare ecological: ecological is more scientific, environmental is broader.
normal.cn: 对比 ecological：ecological 更偏科学，environmental 范围更广。

abstract.en: Picture a green ring drawn around a crowded city.
abstract.cn: 想象一座拥挤的城市外围画着一圈绿色。

abstract.en: Imagine a label on a product that shows a small leaf.
abstract.cn: 想象产品标签上画着一片小叶子。

abstract.en: Think of a scientist measuring the air above a factory.
abstract.cn: 想象科学家在测量工厂上方的空气。

examples.en: Environmental damage can take decades to repair.
examples.cn: 环境破坏可能需要几十年才能修复。

examples.en: The school joined a national environmental campaign.
examples.cn: 这所学校参加了全国性的环保活动。

examples.en: They bought environmental cleaning products for the office.
examples.cn: 他们为办公室购买了环保清洁用品。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「environment + al」——给「环境」加上形容词尾巴，就变成「环境的」；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 environ（在周围）＋ -ment ＋ -al → environmental，核心义「与周围环境有关的」。

sensesIntro.en: Environmental begins with the natural world, still covers surrounding conditions, and often means actively friendly to nature.
sensesIntro.cn: environmental 从自然界开始，仍涵盖周围条件，并常表示积极有利于自然。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ring of nature drawn around human activity.
core.cn: 核心意象：人类活动周围画着一圈自然。

branches.en: The natural-world sense is the main modern use.
branches.cn: 自然界的义项是现代主要用法。

branches.en: Surrounding conditions keep the older spatial sense.
branches.cn: 周围条件保留较老的空间含义。

branches.en: Being friendly to nature is a practical extension.
branches.cn: 对自然友好是实用的延伸。

branches.en: Nature is the largest set of conditions around us.
branches.cn: 自然界是围绕我们最大的条件集合。

branches.en: Protecting nature is the aim behind green choices.
branches.cn: 保护自然是环保选择背后的目标。

intro.en: Environmental stacks -al on environment, itself environ plus -ment.
intro.cn: environmental 在 environment 上叠加 -al，而 environment 本身是 environ 加 -ment。

latinIntro.en: The French verb environ, to surround, comes from viron, a circle.
latinIntro.cn: 法语动词 environ（围绕）来自 viron（圆圈）。

items.example: Environmentally stresses the point of view.
items.exampleCN: environmentally 强调看问题的角度。

definition_zh: 设想；预见；正视
definition_en: to imagine or expect a future situation, and to plan with it in mind
core_image: 会议桌尽头的人把明年的排产表在脑中提前摊开，像把一条还没修的路先走了一遍
scene: 校方设想明年扩招。We envisage a modest rise in places.
sceneCN: 这里 envisage 是「设想；预见」（第 1 个义项：在脑中提前看到尚未发生的情形）；句意：我们预计名额小幅增加。

senses.title: To see ahead in the mind
senses.definition: to form a picture of a future state of affairs before it happens
senses.definitionCN: 在事情发生之前先在头脑中形成其图景
senses.example: Designers envisage a quieter campus.
senses.exampleCN: 设计者设想出一个更安静的校园。
senses.why: The prefix en- puts the eye on the thing, and vision supplies the seeing.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 en- 把目光投向对象，vision 提供看的动作。

senses.title: To plan on the assumption
senses.definition: to include a future condition in an arrangement or schedule
senses.definitionCN: 把未来的条件计入某项安排或计划之中
senses.example: The timetable envisages two evening runs.
senses.exampleCN: 时刻表预计加开两班夜车。
senses.why: Official prose moved from imagining to budgeting, so the verb now governs plans.
senses.whyCN: 公文用法从想象走向预算，动词因此管起计划来。

senses.title: To face a difficulty squarely
senses.definition: to confront an unpleasant problem rather than turn from it
senses.definitionCN: 直面令人不快的难题而不回避
senses.example: The report envisages a funding gap.
senses.exampleCN: 报告正视资金缺口问题。
senses.why: The older sense was literally to look something in the face, and the image survives here.
senses.whyCN: 古义本就是直视对方脸庞，这一意象在此保留下来。

intro.en: Envisage joins en- to vis, the seeing stem, with a verbal ending supplied through French.
intro.cn: envisage 把 en- 与表看的词干 vis 结合，动词词尾经由法语补足。

items.en: Videre means to see.
items.cn: videre 意为看。

items.en: Visus gives the noun of sight.
items.cn: visus 派生出视觉的名词。

items.en: Envis means the face or the sight of a thing.
items.cn: envis 指脸庞或某物映入眼帘之态。

items.en: Envisager means to confront with the eyes.
items.cn: envisager 意为用双眼面对。

items.en: English borrows envisage with the literal sense of facing.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语借入 envisage，本义为直面。

items.en: Business and official writing shift the verb toward expectation.
items.cn: 十九世纪商务与公文用法把词义推向预期。

note.en: Group one holds the vis family and the English twin; group two holds other verbs of foreseeing.
note.cn: 第一组是 vis 词族与英语同源孪生词；第二组是其他表预见的动词。

entries.definition: The preferred verb in American writing for the same act.
entries.definitionCN: 美式写作中同一动作的首选动词。

entries.definition: Sight itself, or the foresight credited to a leader.
entries.definitionCN: 指视力，或称赞领导者具有的远见。

entries.definition: Able to be seen, from the identical Latin root.
entries.definitionCN: 可见的，出自同一拉丁词根。

entries.definition: The act of envisaging, mostly found in older prose.
entries.definitionCN: 设想之举，多见于早期文体。

entries.definition: To expect and prepare for what is coming.
entries.definitionCN: 预先期待并为之准备。

entries.definition: The ordinary verb for knowing beforehand.
entries.definitionCN: 事先知道的日常动词。

entries.definition: To form an image of something in the mind.
entries.definitionCN: 在脑中形成某物的画面。

entries.definition: To consider a possibility steadily, often as an option.
entries.definitionCN: 持续考量某种可能，多作为备选。

normalIntro.en: Envisage is the British formal habit; envision is the everyday American choice.
normalIntro.cn: envisage 是英式正式用法，envision 是美式日常选择。

normal.en: Follow it with a noun clause or a gerund, not an infinitive.
normal.cn: 后接名词从句或动名词，不接不定式。

normal.en: Its object is a situation, plan or outcome, not a person.
normal.cn: 宾语是局面、计划或结果，而不是人。

normal.en: Passive forms are common: the scheme was envisaged by the board.
normal.cn: 被动式常见：该方案由董事会设想。

normal.en: Pair with adverbs like realistically, originally, ambitiously.
normal.cn: 常与 realistically、originally、ambitiously 等副词连用。

normal.en: In American prose, swap it for envision without loss of sense.
normal.cn: 在美式文章中可无损地换成 envision。

abstract.en: Picture a surveyor walking a road that is not yet paved.
abstract.cn: 想象测量员走过一条尚未铺装的路。

abstract.en: Imagine turning a stalled car problem to face you and looking it in the eye.
abstract.cn: 想象把棘手的故障转到面前，与它对视。

abstract.en: Think of a budget drawn before the money arrives.
abstract.cn: 想想钱还没到账就先画好的预算表。

examples.en: Planners envisage the line opening within three years.
examples.cn: 规划者设想该线路三年以内通车。

examples.en: No one envisaged a shutdown lasting that long.
examples.cn: 没有人预想到停运会持续这么久。

examples.en: The clause was drafted as ministers originally envisage it.
examples.cn: 该条款按部长们最初的设想起草。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因未视」——因为还没亲眼看见，只能先在脑中看一遍，所以 envisage 是设想、预见；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（朝向）＋ videre（看）→ vis（所见）→ 古法语 envis（脸庞、映入眼帘）＋ 动词后缀 -age → 英语 envisage，核心义「把目光提前投向尚未发生之事」。

sensesIntro.en: The verb runs from mental preview, through planning language, to the older demand that one face a problem.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词从脑内预演，经过计划用语，再到要求直面难题的古义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the eye sent forward onto a scene that has not yet arrived.
core.cn: 核心意象：把目光提前投到尚未到场的画面上。

branches.en: The mind supplies the picture before the event.
branches.cn: 事件之前由头脑提供画面。

branches.en: Institutions write that picture into schedules.
branches.cn: 机构把这幅画面写进日程。

branches.en: Turning toward a problem is itself an act of seeing.
branches.cn: 转向难题本身就是一种看见。

branches.en: Both treat the future as something already visible.
branches.cn: 两者都把未来当作已经可见之物。

branches.en: Both belong to formal decision-making prose.
branches.cn: 两者都属于正式的决策文体。

intro.en: A prefix of direction meets a stem of sight and takes a French verbal ending.
intro.cn: 表方向的前缀遇上表视觉的词干，再带上法语的动词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre is to see, visus is sight, and provisus is foreseen.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 表看，visus 表视觉，provisus 表已被预见。

items.exampleCN: 建立在 vision 上的姊妹词。

items.example: Re- repeats the same seeing stem.
items.exampleCN: re- 重复同一表看词干。
super- 在上层加上观看者。

definition_zh: 想象；展望；预想
definition_en: to picture something in the mind as a future possibility or ambition
core_image: 设计师把空地上方叠出一层透明的楼影，先看见，再动手画线
scene: 团队展望一座不用停车场的校区。We envision a campus without parking decks.
sceneCN: 这里 envision 是「展望；预想」（第 1 个义项：在脑中加入尚未存在的画面）；句意：我们设想一座没有停车楼的校园。

collocations.zh: 如决策者所设想的那样

senses.title: To form a mental scene of the future
senses.definition: to imagine a situation that does not yet exist as though it were in front of the eye
senses.definitionCN: 把尚不存在的情境想象得如眼前实景
senses.example: She envisioned a quieter working life.
senses.exampleCN: 她设想出一种更安静的工作生活。
senses.why: Vision names the inner eye, and en- sends that eye outward onto a scene.
senses.whyCN: vision 指内心的眼睛，en- 把这只眼投向画面。

senses.title: To foresee as a likely outcome
senses.definition: to regard a result as probable and speak of it in advance
senses.definitionCN: 把某种结果视为可能并提前述说
senses.example: The audit envisioned a smaller deficit.
senses.exampleCN: 审计预计赤字将会缩小。
senses.why: Commercial and legal writing stretched the verb from daydream to forecast.
senses.whyCN: 商业与法律文体把动词从白日梦拉伸到预测。

senses.title: To see with admiration or dread
senses.definition: to catch sight of something in imagination, often in a moment of feeling
senses.definitionCN: 在想象中瞥见某物，多伴随情绪的一瞬
senses.example: He envisioned smoke on the horizon.
senses.exampleCN: 他仿佛望见地平线上升起的烟。
senses.why: The literal older use of vision as sight leaves this rarer, more pictorial sense.
senses.whyCN: vision 表视觉的字面古义留下了这个更罕见也更画面化的义项。

intro.en: Envision pairs the prefix en- with vision, and is an English building on Latin roots rather than a borrowed French verb.
intro.cn: envision 由前缀 en- 与 vision 拼合，是用拉丁词根在英语里自建之词，而非法语借词。

items.en: Videre means to see.
items.cn: videre 意为看。

items.en: Visio names the act or faculty of seeing.
items.cn: visio 命名看的动作与能力。

items.en: Vision enters English by way of French visiun.
items.cn: vision 经法语 visiun 进入英语。

items.en: En- is attached to vision in English texts.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语文献把 en- 接在 vision 之前。

items.en: The verb settles into the sense of imagining ahead of time.
items.cn: 十九世纪该动词定型为提前想象之义。

items.en: Advertising and politics adopt it for stated ambitions.
items.cn: 二十世纪广告与政治用它表述抱负。

note.en: Group one holds the vision family; group two holds other verbs of forming mental pictures.
note.cn: 第一组是 vision 词族；第二组是其他表构想的动词。

entries.definition: The formal British near-synonym, often of plans.
entries.definitionCN: 英式正式的近义词，多用于计划。

entries.definition: Sight, imagination, or the thing seen in the mind.
entries.definitionCN: 视力、想象，或脑中所见之象。

entries.definition: One who plans by pictures rather than by profit.
entries.definitionCN: 以蓝图而非利益谋划的人。

entries.definition: To look over again, sharing the Latin stem of sight.
entries.definitionCN: 再看一遍，共享拉丁语的看词干。

entries.definition: The neutral verb for forming pictures in the mind.
entries.definitionCN: 在脑中构像的中性动词。

entries.definition: To see the event before it arrives.
entries.definitionCN: 在事件到来之前先看见。

entries.definition: To form a scene so clear it feels visible.
entries.definitionCN: 形成清晰得近乎可见的场景。

entries.definition: To make a mental image deliberately, common in sport.
entries.definitionCN: 刻意制造脑中影像，体育训练中常用。

normalIntro.en: Envision adds a prefix to a noun already in English; envisage came in whole from French.
normalIntro.cn: envision 是在英语既有名词前加前缀；envisage 则整个借自法语。

normal.en: American writing prefers envision; British writing often prefers envisage.
normal.cn: 美式写作偏爱 envision，英式常用 envisage。

normal.en: Take a clause with that, or a noun phrase as object.
normal.cn: 可接 that 从句，或以名词短语作宾语。

normal.en: Envision oneself plus a gerund places the speaker inside the scene.
normal.cn: envision oneself 加动名词让人置身场景之内。

normal.en: It suits ambitions, not fears, in most news copy.
normal.cn: 在多数新闻稿中它搭配抱负而非恐惧。

normal.en: Avoid confusing it with vision itself, which is the faculty.
normal.cn: 不要与表视觉能力的名词 vision 混淆。

abstract.en: Picture an architect tracing a building over empty land.
abstract.cn: 想象建筑师在空地上临摹一座楼。

abstract.en: Imagine a runner finishing the race in her head before the start gun.
abstract.cn: 想象跑者在发令枪前先在脑内冲过终点。

abstract.en: Think of a company poster that shows a product not yet made.
abstract.cn: 想想公司海报上那件尚未生产的产品。

examples.en: Reformers envisioned a city with free libraries.
examples.cn: 改革者设想过一座拥有免费图书馆的城市。

examples.en: He could not envision life without the instrument.
examples.cn: 他无法想象没有这件乐器的生活。

examples.en: Few investors envisioned a return this quick.
examples.cn: 很少有投资者预想过这样快的回报。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因维任」——因为要在脑里先维护一段任途的画面，所以 envision 是展望、设想；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（朝向）＋ videre（看）→ visio（看见之物）→ 英语 vision ＋ 前缀 en-（使……）→ envision，核心义「让内心的眼睛先看到尚未存在之物」。

sensesIntro.en: The verb covers ambition, forecast, and a rarer pictorial glimpse.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词涵盖抱负、预测，以及较罕见的画面一瞥。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an inner eye placed on a scene the outside world has not yet built.
core.cn: 核心意象：把内心的眼睛投向外部世界尚未搭出的场景。

branches.en: Desire writes the first draft of the scene.
branches.cn: 愿望写下场景的最初草稿。

branches.en: Judgment turns the draft into an expectation.
branches.cn: 判断把草稿变成预期。

branches.en: Feeling supplies a single glimpse instead of a plan.
branches.cn: 情绪提供的是一瞥而非规划。

branches.en: Both project forward from the present.
branches.cn: 两者都从现在向前投射。

branches.en: Both depend on an image rather than an argument.
branches.cn: 两者都依赖画面而非论证。

intro.en: A productive prefix attaches to a noun of sight already naturalised in English.
intro.cn: 一个能产的前缀接在英语里早已本土化的视觉名词上。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre is to see, visio is sight, and provisio is foresight.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 表看，visio 表视觉，provisio 表先见。

items.example: En- turns vision into an action.
items.exampleCN: en- 把 vision 变为动作。

items.example: Vision is the base of the verb.
A sibling noun of the same stem.

items.exampleCN: super- 加上一层看护的目光。

definition_zh: 使节；特使；代表
definition_en: a representative or messenger sent by a government or organisation to negotiate or act on its behalf
core_image: 城门放行一人一骑，他怀里揣着的不是自己的话，而是另一座城的口信
scene: 董事会派出一名特使前往港口。The board sent an envoy to the port.
sceneCN: 这里 envoy 是「特使；使者」（第 2 个义项：受派代行的代表）；句意：董事会派出一名特使前往港口。

collocations.zh: 使节们举行了两次会谈

senses.title: A minister of the highest rank
senses.definition: a diplomatic agent accredited to a court or state below the rank of ambassador
senses.definitionCN: 派驻朝廷或国家、级别低于大使的外交官
senses.example: The envoy presented no credentials at court.
senses.exampleCN: 那位公使未向朝廷递交国书。
senses.why: Historical protocol ranked envoys below ambassadors, who carried a sovereign's full voice.
senses.whyCN: 旧时礼制把 envoy 排在 ambassador 之下，后者才代表君主全权。

senses.title: Anyone sent to speak for others
senses.definition: a person dispatched by a body to carry a message or conduct a negotiation
senses.definitionCN: 受某个机构派遣传送信息或进行谈判的人
senses.example: Neighbours chose an envoy for the dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 邻居们为这场争执推选了一位使者。
senses.why: The French verb meant to send a thing off, so the noun is the one sent.
senses.whyCN: 法语动词本义是把物件送出，名词即被送出之人。

senses.title: A short closing stanza
senses.definition: a brief dedicatory passage sent at the end of a poem or book
senses.definitionCN: 置于诗或书末尾、呈送他人的简短献词
senses.example: The poet added an envoy of four lines.
senses.exampleCN: 诗人补上了四行尾声。
senses.why: The literary sense keeps the oldest spelling of the same sending word.
senses.whyCN: 文学义项保留了同一送呈之词最古老的拼法。

intro.en: Envoy runs back through French envoyer, to send, which inherited its sense from Latin involvere, to wrap up.
intro.cn: envoy 可追溯到法语 envoyer「送出」，而它的词义承自拉丁语 involvere「包裹起来」。

items.en: Volvere means to roll.
items.cn: volvere 意为滚动。

items.en: Involvere means to wrap up or roll in.
items.cn: involvere 意为卷入或包好。

items.en: The wrapped object came to be the message dispatched.
items.cn: 被包好的物件转而指送出的信函。

items.en: Envoyer and envoi carry the sense of sending.
items.cn: envoyer 与 envoi 承载送呈之义。

items.en: Fourteenth-century English records envoy as an errand or mission.
items.cn: 十四世纪英语记录 envoy，指差事或使命。

items.en: Diplomacy narrowed it to the agent sent; poetry kept the tailpiece.
items.cn: 现代英语中外交用法收窄为受派之人，诗体保留尾声义。

note.en: Group one holds relatives of the French sending verb; group two holds other words for representatives.
note.cn: 第一组是法语「送出」动词的亲族；第二组是其他表代表者的词。

entries.definition: The dedicatory passage, written in the French form.
entries.definitionCN: 献辞段落，采用法语拼写。

entries.definition: The learned borrowing of the same Latin verb.
entries.definitionCN: 同一拉丁动词的书面借入形式。

entries.definition: A sent list of goods and prices, from the same French stock.
entries.definitionCN: 送出之货物价目单，同出法语一系。

entries.definition: The mission or building that houses envoys.
entries.definitionCN: 容纳使节的使团或馆舍。

entries.definition: The senior representative of one state to another.
entries.definitionCN: 国与国之间级别最高的代表。

entries.definition: A person sent on a private or covert errand.
entries.definitionCN: 受派执行私密或秘密差事的人。

entries.definition: One chosen to vote or speak for a group.
entries.definitionCN: 被选出代表群体发言或表决之人。

entries.definition: An official deputy of a ruler or of the pope.
entries.definitionCN: 君主或教皇的正式代理使臣。

normalIntro.en: Envoy names the person sent; embassy names the mission or the building.
normalIntro.cn: envoy 指被派的人，embassy 指使团或馆舍。

normal.en: Special envoy is the standard title in news about mediation.
normal.cn: 在调停新闻里 special envoy 是标准头衔。

normal.en: Say envoy to a place or a body, not envoy for a building.
normal.cn: 搭配 envoy to 加地点或机构，不接馆舍。

normal.en: The plural adds s: envoys, without changing the stress.
normal.cn: 复数加 s 成 envoys，重音不变。

normal.en: In literature, an envoy is a tailpiece, not a person.
normal.cn: 文学术语中 envoy 是尾声，而非人物。

normal.en: Ambassador outranks envoy in formal protocol.
normal.cn: 正式礼宾序列中 ambassador 高于 envoy。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed packet handed over at a city gate.
abstract.cn: 想象城门前递出的那只封好的包裹。

abstract.en: Imagine a rider who carries only words, never weapons.
abstract.cn: 想象一位只带口信不带兵器的骑手。

abstract.en: Think of the last stanza that bows and leaves the room.
abstract.cn: 想想最后一段诗，鞠躬离场。

examples.en: The envoy was recalled after six months.
examples.cn: 那位特使六个月后被召回。

examples.en: A retired judge served as envoy to the talks.
examples.cn: 一位退休法官出任谈判代表。

examples.en: Few readers reach the envoy at the poem's end.
examples.cn: 很少读者会读到诗末那段献辞。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「按我意」——君主按自己的意思把人派出去传话回禀，所以 envoy 是特使、使节；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（向内）＋ volvere（滚）→ involvere（包好送出）→ 古法语 envoyer／envoi（送呈）→ 中古英语 envoy，核心义「被包裹送出的人或话」。

sensesIntro.en: The noun covers ranked diplomats, any dispatched representative, and a poetic tailpiece.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个名词涵盖有级别的使节、任何被派出的代表，以及诗体尾声。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wrapped message given to a person who must travel with it.
core.cn: 核心意象：包好的信函交给必须携之上路的人。

branches.en: Protocol fixes how far the speaker may go.
branches.cn: 礼制规定了说话者可走到哪一步。

branches.en: Any body may send a mouthpiece for a task.
branches.cn: 任何机构都可派出代言人行事。

branches.en: A text too can be dispatched to a patron.
branches.cn: 一部作品同样可呈送给赞助人。

branches.en: Both act under someone else's authority.
branches.cn: 两者都依他人授权行事。

branches.en: Both preserve the older idea of something sent off.
branches.cn: 两者都保留「送出之物」的旧观念。

intro.en: A French sending verb supplies the stem, and an English ending shapes the agent noun.
intro.cn: 法语表送出的动词提供词干，英语词尾把它塑造成行为者名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin involvere is to wrap up, mittere to send, and legare to depute.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 involvere 表包裹，mittere 表送出，legare 表委派。

items.exampleCN: en- 位于法语动词开头。

items.example: The Latin source of the family.
English borrowed it twice, once as envoy.
items.exampleCN: 英语两次借入，其一拼作 envoy。

items.example: News headlines use the plural often.
The suffix marks the post held.
A near synonym in official prose.

items.exampleCN: 使节须经委任而非雇佣。

definition_zh: 流行病；（坏事）迅速蔓延；流行性的
definition_en: a disease that spreads quickly through many people, or the rapid spread of something bad
core_image: 一条街接一条街，病人越来越多，像波纹扩散
scene: 那年冬天，流感在城里迅速蔓延。That winter, a flu epidemic swept through the city.
sceneCN: 这里 epidemic 是「流行病」（第 1 个义项：在人群中快速传播的疾病）；句意：那年冬天，流感在城里迅速蔓延。

senses.title: A quickly spreading disease
senses.definition: an infectious disease that spreads rapidly among many people in an area
senses.definitionCN: 在一个地区人群中迅速传播的传染病
senses.example: The city closed its schools during the epidemic.
senses.exampleCN: 疫情期间，这座城市关闭了学校。
senses.why: The Greek root means among the people, so a disease running through a whole population is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根意为「在民众之中」，因此贯穿整个人群的疾病是第一个义项。

senses.title: The rapid spread of something bad
senses.definition: a rapid increase or spread of something harmful or unwanted
senses.definitionCN: 有害或不受欢迎之物的迅速增加或扩散
senses.example: Experts warn of an epidemic of online fraud.
senses.exampleCN: 专家警告网络诈骗正在迅速蔓延。
senses.why: The image of disease spreading is borrowed for any harmful trend.
senses.whyCN: 疾病传播的意象被借用来指任何有害趋势。

senses.title: Affecting many people at once
senses.definition: used as an adjective for something that spreads widely at one time
senses.definitionCN: 作形容词，指在某一时期广泛传播的事物
senses.example: Obesity has become an epidemic problem in many countries.
senses.exampleCN: 肥胖在许多国家已成为普遍性问题。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the same spreading idea and applies it to conditions or problems.
senses.whyCN: 形容词保留同样的「扩散」概念，并用于状况或问题。

intro.en: Epidemic comes from Greek epidemos, among the people, from epi-, upon, and demos, the people.
intro.cn: epidemic 来自希腊语 epidemos（在民众之中），由 epi-（在上）与 demos（民众）构成。

items.en: Demos means the people.
items.cn: demos 意为民众。

items.en: Epi- means upon or among.
items.cn: epi- 意为在上或在……之中。

items.en: Epidemos means among the people.
items.cn: epidemos 意为在民众之中。

items.en: Epidemia names a disease visiting a whole population.
items.cn: epidemia 指降临整个人群的疾病。

items.en: French épidémie carries the medical sense.
items.cn: 法语 épidémie 保留医学含义。

items.en: Modern English extends epidemic to any rapid spread.
items.cn: 现代英语把 epidemic 扩展到任何迅速蔓延。

note.en: Epidemic is a spreading word from the demos family, near outbreak words and near its own technical relatives.
note.cn: epidemic 是来自 demos 词族的「扩散」词，与疫情词以及自身技术词族相邻。

entries.definition: the study of how diseases spread
entries.definitionCN: 流行病学

entries.definition: a specialist in disease spread
entries.definitionCN: 流行病学家

entries.definition: regularly found in a particular place
entries.definitionCN: 地方性的

entries.definition: a sudden start of disease or violence
entries.definitionCN: 暴发；突然发生

entries.definition: a deadly widespread disease
entries.definitionCN: 瘟疫

entries.definition: a disease spreading across the world
entries.definitionCN: 全球性流行病

normalIntro.en: Epidemic is epi- plus demos: a disease that settles upon the whole people.
normalIntro.cn: epidemic 是 epi- 加 demos：一种落到全体民众身上的疾病。

normal.en: Demos means people, and epidemic spreads among people.
normal.cn: demos 意为民众，epidemic 就在人群中传播。

normal.en: A flu epidemic sends many people to bed at once.
normal.cn: 流感流行会让许多人同时病倒。

normal.en: Epidemic proportions means a very large scale.
normal.cn: epidemic proportions 表示极大的规模。

normal.en: Epidemiology is the study of how epidemics move.
normal.cn: epidemiology 研究流行病如何传播。

normal.en: Compare endemic: endemic stays in one place, epidemic spreads.
normal.cn: 对比 endemic：endemic 局限一地，epidemic 会扩散。

abstract.en: Picture rings of illness widening street by street.
abstract.cn: 想象疾病像波纹一样一条街一条街地扩大。

abstract.en: Imagine a red dot spreading across a map of a city.
abstract.cn: 想象一个红点在城市地图上扩散。

abstract.en: Think of a rumor passing from door to door.
abstract.cn: 想象一则谣言从一扇门传到另一扇门。

examples.en: Doctors worked day and night to stop the epidemic.
examples.cn: 医生们日夜工作以阻止流行病蔓延。

examples.en: The report describes an epidemic of loneliness among the elderly.
examples.cn: 报告描述了老年人中普遍存在的孤独问题。

examples.en: Epidemic diseases spread fastest where people live close together.
examples.cn: 在人们居住密集的地方，流行性疾病传播得最快。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「epi + demic」——疾病「压在」众人头上，就成了流行病；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 epi-（在上）＋ demos（民众）→ epidemos（在民众之中）→ epidemia（流行病）→ 英语 epidemic，核心义「在人群之中扩散」。

sensesIntro.en: Epidemic begins as a disease among the people, extends to any harmful spread, and then works as an adjective.
sensesIntro.cn: epidemic 从人群中的疾病开始，扩展到任何有害的蔓延，再作形容词使用。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: illness moving through a whole population.
core.cn: 核心意象：疾病穿过整个人群。

branches.en: A spreading disease is the original medical sense.
branches.cn: 传播中的疾病是最初的医学义项。

branches.en: Any harmful spread borrows the disease image.
branches.cn: 任何有害蔓延都借用了疾病的意象。

branches.en: The adjective describes what affects many at once.
branches.cn: 形容词描述同时影响许多人的事物。

branches.en: Both a virus and a fraud wave move quickly through crowds.
branches.cn: 病毒与诈骗浪潮都在人群中快速移动。

branches.en: A disease becomes epidemic when it reaches many people.
branches.cn: 疾病在波及许多人时成为流行性的。

intro.en: Epidemic is built from Greek epi- and demos, with a large English family in epidemiology and its forms.
intro.cn: epidemic 由希腊语 epi- 与 demos 构成，英语词族在 epidemiology 及其派生词中扩展。

latinIntro.en: Greek epi- means upon, and demos means the people.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 epi- 意为在上，demos 意为民众。

items.example: Epi- places the disease upon the people.
items.exampleCN: epi- 把疾病置于民众之上。
epidemos 把两部分组合起来。

items.example: Epidemia is the Greek medical noun.
items.exampleCN: epidemia 是希腊语医学名词。
epidemiology 研究疾病如何传播。

definition_zh: 癫痫；癫痫症
definition_en: a brain disorder in which a person has repeated seizures caused by sudden electrical surges
core_image: 脑内一场毫无预告的雷暴，几分钟后云散雨停，患者醒过来却对刚才一无所知
scene: 体育课上老师解释同学的病情。Epilepsy is a treatable brain disorder.
sceneCN: 这里 epilepsy 是「癫痫症」（第 1 个义项：反复抽搐发作的慢性脑病）；句意：癫痫是可以治疗的脑病。

senses.title: A chronic disorder of recurrent seizures
senses.definition: the medical condition marked by two or more unprovoked seizures over time
senses.definitionCN: 以两次以上无诱因发作为特征的医学病症
senses.example: Childhood epilepsy often settles with age.
senses.exampleCN: 儿童期癫痫常随年龄增长而缓解。
senses.why: The Greek stem says a seizure comes over a person from outside, like something grabbing hold.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词干说的是发作从外部攫住患者，如同被一只手抓住。

senses.title: The state of being liable to fits
senses.definition: the disposition that makes a person expect an attack without warning
senses.definitionCN: 使人无从预告便预期发作的身体倾向
senses.example: Stress can worsen epilepsy.
senses.exampleCN: 压力会使癫痫加重。
senses.why: Clinical prose uses the noun for the tendency itself, not only for the diagnosed disease.
senses.whyCN: 临床书写用该名词指倾向本身，而不止指确诊之病。

senses.title: The disease once called sacred
senses.definition: the historical name for a condition attributed to divine visitation or the moon
senses.definitionCN: 历史上把此病归因于神罚或月象的旧称
senses.example: Ancient writers feared epilepsy as a heaven-sent blow.
senses.exampleCN: 古人视癫痫为天降一击而心生畏惧。
senses.why: Hippocrates argued against that reading, and the word survived with the argument attached.
senses.whyCN: 希波克拉底反驳这一解释，词语连同那段辩论一并留存至今。

intro.en: Epilepsy is Greek for a seizing, from epi- upon plus lambanein to take hold.
intro.cn: epilepsy 在希腊语中意为被攫住，由 epi-「在上」与 lambanein「抓住」合成。

items.en: Lambanein means to take or seize.
items.cn: lambanein 意为抓取。

items.en: Epilambanein means to come over someone and seize them.
items.cn: epilambanein 意为临身攫人。

items.en: Epilepsia named the disease that falls upon a person.
items.cn: epilepsia 命名了骤然临身的疾病。

items.en: Hippocratic writing rejected the label of sacred disease.
items.cn: 希波克拉底文献否定了圣病这一标签。

items.en: Epilepsia passed through medical Latin and French epilepsie.
items.cn: epilepsia 经医学拉丁语与法语 epilepsie 转手。

items.en: Neurology fixed the definition on recurrent unprovoked seizures.
items.cn: 现代神经病学把它界定为反复无诱因发作。

note.en: Group one holds words sharing the Greek ending for a seizing; group two holds other words for sudden loss of control.
note.cn: 第一组共用希腊语表攫获的词尾；第二组是其他表骤然失控的词。

entries.definition: Describes the attack or the person who has attacks.
entries.definitionCN: 既可修饰发作，也可指患者本人。

entries.definition: Sudden sleep attacks, built on numbness plus seizing.
entries.definitionCN: 骤然入睡之症，由麻痹加攫获构成。

entries.definition: A neurologist who concentrates on seizure disorders.
entries.definitionCN: 专攻发作性疾病的神经科医生。

entries.definition: A stroke, from the same Greek family of striking down.
entries.definitionCN: 中风旧称，同出希腊语击倒一词族。

entries.definition: One attack, used whether or not the disease is chronic.
entries.definitionCN: 单次发作，无论是否慢性病均可使用。

entries.definition: Violent involuntary contraction of the muscles.
entries.definitionCN: 肌肉剧烈的不自主收缩。

entries.definition: The plain household term for an attack.
entries.definitionCN: 日常口语中对发作的称呼。

entries.definition: A brief loss of consciousness without electrical storm.
entries.definitionCN: 短暂失去意识而无异常放电。

normalIntro.en: Epilepsy names the condition; seizure names one episode of it.
normalIntro.cn: epilepsy 指病症本身，seizure 指其中一次发作。

normal.en: Treat it as uncountable and use no article before the bare noun.
normal.cn: 作不可数名词，裸形前不加冠词。

normal.en: Say a child with epilepsy, not an epilepsy.
normal.cn: 说 a child with epilepsy，不说 an epilepsy。

normal.en: Pair with verbs such as diagnose, control, manage.
normal.cn: 搭配 diagnose、control、manage 等动词。

normal.en: The adjective epileptic modifies seizure or attack.
normal.cn: 形容词 epileptic 修饰 seizure 或 attack。

normal.en: Avoid outdated slang in essays and reports.
normal.cn: 写作与报道中回避过时俗称。

abstract.en: Picture a lightswitch thrown by someone else's hand.
abstract.cn: 想象电闸被另一只手猛地拉下。

abstract.en: Imagine a storm cell crossing one field in a wide plain, then moving on.
abstract.cn: 想象雷雨云团扫过平原上的一小块田地，随即远去。

abstract.en: Think of a video that skips for a minute and then resumes.
abstract.cn: 想想一段跳掉一分钟又继续播放的录像。

examples.en: She was diagnosed with epilepsy at nine.
examples.cn: 她九岁时被确诊患有癫痫。

examples.en: New drugs keep many cases of epilepsy under control.
examples.cn: 新药使许多癫痫病例得到控制。

examples.en: The syllabus now explains epilepsy to younger pupils.
examples.cn: 教学大纲如今向低龄学生讲解癫痫知识。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一劈雷熄」——发作时像被雷劈倒，一番抽搐后又如雷声熄灭般醒转，所以 epilepsy 是癫痫；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 epi-（在上、临身）＋ lambanein（抓取）→ epilambanein（临身攫人）→ epilepsia（被攫住之病）→ 拉丁语 epilepsia → 法语 epilepsie → 英语 epilepsy，核心义「从外面抓住患者的病」。

sensesIntro.en: The noun covers the diagnosed disease, the tendency to attack, and the older sacred-disease idea.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个名词涵盖确诊之病、发作倾向，以及圣病的旧观念。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something outside the body takes hold of a person for a few minutes.
core.cn: 核心意象：体外之力将人攫住几分钟，随后松手。

branches.en: Medicine counts the attacks to name the disease.
branches.cn: 医学以发作次数界定病症。

branches.en: The body keeps a standing liability to be grabbed.
branches.cn: 身体保有被攫住的持续可能。

branches.en: Older cultures blamed powers from above.
branches.cn: 古代文化把病因归于上天之力。

branches.en: Both describe the electrical event, not its explanation.
branches.cn: 两者都描述放电事件而非其解释。

branches.en: Both treat the sufferer as acted upon rather than acting.
branches.cn: 两者都把患者视为被作用者而非施动者。

intro.en: A Greek prefix of position joins a verb of seizing, and the disease takes a noun ending.
intro.cn: 希腊语表位置的前缀接上表抓取的动词，病症再带名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Greek lambanein is to take, and the prefix keeps its Greek shape epi-.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 lambanein 表抓取，拉丁语一侧则常见前缀 epi-。

items.example: Epi- marks the power coming over.
The ending closes the disease name.

items.exampleCN: narco- 加 lepsy 构成嗜睡症。
apo- 加 plexy 构成中风一词。

definition_zh: 一集；一段经历；发作期
definition_en: one part of a series, or a single event in a longer story
core_image: 一条长线被分成几段，每段都有自己的开头和结尾
scene: 这部纪录片的第三集讲的是深海生物。The third episode of the documentary looks at deep-sea life.
sceneCN: 这里 episode 是「一集」（第 1 个义项：系列节目中的一个部分）；句意：这部纪录片的第三集讲的是深海生物。

senses.title: One part of a series
senses.definition: one program in a television or radio series
senses.definitionCN: 电视或广播系列节目中的一期
senses.example: The final episode answered every question.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一集回答了所有疑问。
senses.why: Greek epeisodion meant an interlude between choral songs, and a single part of a series keeps that sense of a bounded section.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 epeisodion 指合唱之间的插段，系列中的一个部分保留了「有边界的段落」这一含义。

senses.title: A single event in a longer story
senses.definition: one event or period within a longer series of events
senses.definitionCN: 较长事件序列中的一个事件或时期
senses.example: That summer was a strange episode in his life.
senses.exampleCN: 那个夏天是他人生中一段奇怪的经历。
senses.why: A bounded section of a story becomes a bounded event in a life.
senses.whyCN: 故事中有边界的一段，变成人生中有边界的一个事件。

senses.title: A period of illness
senses.definition: a short period when a disease or condition is active
senses.definitionCN: 疾病或症状活跃的一段短时期
senses.example: She had a brief episode of dizziness.
senses.exampleCN: 她有过一小段眩晕发作。
senses.why: Medical use treats a bout of illness as a separate section of time.
senses.whyCN: 医学用法把一次病情发作视为一段独立的时间。

intro.en: Episode comes from Greek epeisodion, an addition or interlude, from epi-, upon, and eisodos, a coming in.
intro.cn: episode 来自希腊语 epeisodion（附加段、插曲），由 epi-（在上）与 eisodos（进入）构成。

items.en: Eisodos means a coming in or entrance.
items.cn: eisodos 意为进入、入场。

items.en: Epeisodion means an added interlude.
items.cn: epeisodion 意为附加的插段。

items.en: The word names a section between choral songs.
items.cn: 这个词指合唱歌曲之间的段落。

items.en: French épisode applies it to a part of a story.
items.cn: 法语 épisode 把它用于故事的一部分。

items.en: Modern English uses episode for series parts, events, and bouts of illness.
items.cn: 现代英语用 episode 指剧集、事件和病情发作。

note.en: Episode is a section word, linked to episodic forms and to words for parts of a whole.
note.cn: episode 是表示「段落」的词，与 episodic 词族以及表示整体之部分的词相邻。

entries.definition: made up of separate parts
entries.definitionCN: 分段的；插曲式的

entries.definition: in separate parts
entries.definitionCN: 以分段方式

entries.definition: episodic
entries.definitionCN: 分段的

entries.definition: one part of a story released in stages
entries.definitionCN: 分期连载的一部分

entries.definition: a main division of a book
entries.definitionCN: 章节

entries.definition: a single event
entries.definitionCN: 事件；插曲

normalIntro.en: Episode is a self-contained section: a show part, a life event, or a bout of illness.
normalIntro.cn: episode 是一个自成一体的段落：一集节目、一段人生经历，或一次病情发作。

normal.en: A TV series is made of episodes.
normal.cn: 电视剧由一集一集的 episode 组成。

normal.en: The first episode introduces the main characters.
normal.cn: 第一集介绍主要人物。

normal.en: A brief episode of rain passed quickly.
normal.cn: 一阵短暂的降雨很快过去了。

normal.en: The adjective episodic means made of separate parts.
normal.cn: 形容词 episodic 意为由分开的部分组成。

normal.en: Compare chapter: chapter is for books, episode suits shows and events.
normal.cn: 对比 chapter：chapter 用于书，episode 适用于节目和事件。

abstract.en: Picture a long ribbon cut into neat sections.
abstract.cn: 想象一条长丝带被剪成整齐的几段。

abstract.en: Imagine a door opening onto one scene and closing again.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门打开呈现一幕，然后又关上。

abstract.en: Think of a short storm passing over a calm sea.
abstract.cn: 想象一场短促的暴风雨掠过平静的海面。

examples.en: We watched the opening episode together.
examples.cn: 我们一起看了开篇那一集。

examples.en: The trip was a happy episode in her childhood.
examples.cn: 那次旅行是她童年中一段快乐的经历。

examples.en: He described a sudden episode of back pain.
examples.cn: 他描述了一次突然发作的背痛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「epi + sode」——一段插进来的小故事，就是一集；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 epi-（在上）＋ eisodos（进入）→ epeisodion（插段）→ 法语 épisode → 英语 episode，核心义「整体中的一个段落」。

sensesIntro.en: Episode starts as an interlude, then becomes one part of a series, a single life event, and a bout of illness.
sensesIntro.cn: episode 从插段开始，随后指系列中的一集、人生中的一个事件，以及一次病情发作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long line divided into bounded sections.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条长线被分成有边界的段落。

branches.en: One part of a series is the everyday media sense.
branches.cn: 系列中的一集是日常媒体义项。

branches.en: A single event is a section of a life story.
branches.cn: 单个事件是人生故事中的一个段落。

branches.en: A bout of illness is a bounded period of time.
branches.cn: 病情发作是一段有边界的时间。

branches.en: Both a show part and a life event have a clear beginning and end.
branches.cn: 一集节目与一段经历都有清楚的起点和终点。

branches.en: An illness episode is also an event in a person's history.
branches.cn: 一次发病也是个人经历中的一个事件。

intro.en: Episode comes from Greek roots, and English adds the adjective and adverb endings -ic and -ally.
intro.cn: episode 来自希腊语词根，英语再加上形容词与副词词尾 -ic 和 -ally。

latinIntro.en: Greek epi- means upon, and eisodos means a coming in.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 epi- 意为在上，eisodos 意为进入。

items.example: Episodically means from time to time.
